NICE Guideline CG150: Headaches in Over 12s Diagnosis and Management | Publisher: National
Tension-Type Headache Self-Care and Management
Tension-type headache is the most common primary headache disorder,
characterized by a dull, aching band-like pain across the forehead or back
of the head.
Self-Care & Non-Pharmacological Management: - Stress Management: Cognitive
relaxation, biofeedback, and regular physical rest. - Hydration:
Maintaining adequate fluid intake throughout the workday. - Posture &
Ergonomics: Ensure proper screen height and chair support to prevent neck
muscle strain. - Limit Medication Use: Avoid taking acute pain medicines
for more than 10-15 days per month to prevent medication-overuse headache
(MOH).
